einzeiler: The History of Rome is now available ad-free on Patreon with extra perks.
kurzfassung: Mike Duncan announces a new Patreon page for listeners who want an ad-free experience of The History of Rome. Patrons gain access to the entire catalog without ads, plus unreleased archival material, new content, and a direct chat community. Additionally, a merchandise store has launched featuring items like the Livia Did It t-shirt.
stichpunkte: Programmatic ads are now being added to History of Rome episodes.
A new Patreon page at patreon.com/thehistoryofrome offers an ad-free listening experience.
Patron tiers include access to the complete catalog without ads.
Subscribers also receive new bonus content, unreleased archival material, and direct Q&A access in a chat community.
A new merchandise store at cottonbureau.com/Mike Duncan offers show-related apparel.
Featured merchandise includes the Livia Did It t-shirt.
Links to the Patreon page and merchandise store are available in the show notes.
The host expresses gratitude to listeners for their long-term support.
beschreibung:
Become a patron and get the entire History of Rome backcatalog ad-fre, plus bonus content, behind the scenes peeks at the new book, plus a chat community where you can talk to me directly. Join today!
Patreon: patreon.com/thehistoryofrome
Merch Store: cottonbureau.com/mikeduncan
